shots.action: Back at road level, 40 D behind the truck (toward the threat, screen left): a dark sedan on its left side across a lane, hazards ticking, steam; a small figure in a white coat working at its windscreen opening. Kong at the truck in the right foreground, turning to it.

shots.cut_on: พลิกตะแคง

captions: พลิกตะแคง

shots.action: The sedan on its left side, roof toward us (the underside is never seen and is not built): hazards ticking on the upper flank, steam, glass crumbs, a briefcase in a puddle. Praew braced at the empty windscreen frame hauling on a navy sleeve.

shots.cut_on: หมอแพรว

captions: หมอแพรว
หมอห้องฉุกเฉิน

shots.action: Praew: hair bun coming loose, white coat soaked over blue scrubs, stethoscope, blue gloves; `determined`, teeth set, pulling with her whole weight (lean -18, feet planted wide).

shots.cut_on: กำลังดึงคุณทศ

captions: กำลังดึงคุณทศ
ออกจากซากรถ

shots.action: Through the windscreen frame: Tos lying on his side in the tipped cabin (card rolled 80 degrees), glasses crooked, navy suit; Praew has his right arm and shoulder out; he does not come further.

shots.cut_on: แต่ประตูที่ยุบ

shots.action: Tos's face, sideways in frame: `angry`-afraid, glasses askew; the buckled door's edge lies across the bottom of the frame pressing him into the seat, and he shoves at it with his free hand; it does not give.

shots.cut_on: ไกลออกไป

shots.action: Long lens back down the lanes (screen left): infected running toward us between the cars, back-lit by headlights and hazards, seen from the waist up over the bonnets (twelve distinct figures, the rest silhouettes); two vault bonnets side-on in the middle distance; phases offset so no two are in step.

shots.cut_on: ก้องชะงัก

shots.action: Kong at the truck door, hand on the handle: eyes go left (the horde), right (the open shoulder ahead), then to the sedan. He does not move.

shots.cut_on: แต่เขา

captions: แต่เขา

shots.action: Kong runs right to left, toward the sedan and the horde, against a stream of extras fleeing left to right past him (run cycle, planted; the cutter in both hands).

shots.cut_on: ก้องเอาเครื่องตัดง้างประตู

shots.action: The hook's S08 jaw staging on new metal: the tips go into the gap between the buckled door frame and the seat and open; the frame bends away in three pushes (pump recoil each time).

shots.cut_on: คุณทศหลุดออกมา

captions: คุณทศหลุดออกมา

shots.action: Tos slides out through the windscreen frame into Praew's and Kong's hands and stands (card roll back to upright over 8 f on the turn out), suit wet and dusty, both sleeves whole, glasses pushed straight.

captions: รอผมด้วย!

shots.action: Up at a car roof: James, visor up, waves one arm and shouts the line (`shouting`), then runs on.

shots.action: James jumps from a bonnet to the road (anticipation crouch, air 5 f, landing crouch with a puddle burst, feet planted) and runs toward the group, left to right.

shots.action: On the bus roof behind him: the junior, infected, drops into a crouch, drawn back by the shout (orange long sleeves, the crest of hair, the torn neck, grey-green skin, red pupils). Kong's head and shoulder are a dark shape at the right edge, turned to him.

shots.cut_on: ทุกคนขึ้นรถกู้ภัย

captions: ทุกคนขึ้นรถกู้ภัย

shots.action: All four run left to right to the truck: James first, Praew with Tos's arm, Kong last and looking back; far behind, heads and shoulders of the horde above the car roofs, closing.

shots.cut_on: หน้าที่แนบกระจก

captions: หน้าที่แนบกระจก

shots.action: From inside: the side window. The junior's face presses to the wet glass, red pupils, teeth, breath fogging; his fingers drag clear lines through the rain. Kong's profile is a dark edge at the right.

shots.action: Reverse: Kong's face through the streaked glass, `guilty`; the shadow of a clawing hand slides across it; he looks away, down, and reaches for the ignition.

shots.action: From the rear bench through the side window as the cab moves off: the junior's palms slide off the wet glass, he runs three steps beside the truck and falls behind; wrecks and the barrier slide past (the camera and cab shell travel along the shoulder; the truck's exterior and wheels are not seen).

shots.cut_on: แต่ข้างหน้า

shots.action: Through the windscreen, wipers beating: the shoulder ahead, then in the headlights a lorry trailer lying across every lane.

shots.cut_on: เต็มถนน

captions: เต็มถนน

shots.action: Low, behind the rescue truck, which has just stopped (nose dips and settles over 6 f, brake lights flaring on the wet road): ahead in its headlights a six-wheel box truck slewed across all three lanes, cab against the left barrier. Beside the cab, at the barrier, a small steel gate under one dim lamp.

shots.cut_on: เปิดไซเรนขอทาง

captions: เปิดไซเรนขอทาง

shots.action: The console: a gloved finger presses a red rocker switch with a hand-lettered label ไซเรน.

shots.cut_on: (picture beat, no word)
shots.action: The light bar and horn on the cab roof: beacons flashing, rain jumping off the horn mouth as the siren hits.

captions: แล้วหันมา
พร้อมกัน

shots.action: Three infected in a row at different depths (office man, auntie without her umbrella, a student): their heads turn to the lens one, two, three on twos; red pupils catch the beacon.

shots.cut_on: ปิดเสียง!

captions: ปิดเสียง!

shots.action: Praew leans forward between the front seats from the rear bench and shouts the line (`shouting`).

shots.cut_on: ก้องปิดไซเรน

captions: ก้องปิดไซเรน

shots.action: The console again, from the side: Kong's palm slaps the switch off.

shots.cut_on: แต่สายไปแล้ว

captions: แต่สายไปแล้ว

shots.action: Kong through the windscreen from the bonnet, a wiper crossing his face: `alarmed`, eyes on the mirror.

captions: ทั้งฝูงรู้แล้ว

shots.action: From the truck's roof looking back and left: the horde comes through four gaps between cars, converging on us, seen from the waist up over the bonnets; two cross a roof side-on.

shots.cut_on: เสียง กับแสง

captions: เสียง กับแสง

shots.action: Kong: eyes to the switch, to the red and blue sweeping over the bonnet, back. He reaches up again and the sweeping light on his face stops: he has cut the beacons too.

shots.cut_on: คือสิ่งที่เรียกมัน

captions: คือสิ่งที่เรียกมัน

shots.action: Outside: the light bar goes dark; a breath later the first two infected hit the truck's flank and it rocks on its springs.

shots.cut_on: ขับไปสิ!

captions: ขับไปสิ!

หรือไง!

shots.action: Tos on the rear bench, lunging forward, finger jabbing at the windscreen, shouting (`angry`); glasses flash white; both suit sleeves still whole.

shots.cut_on: รถข้างหน้า

captions: รถข้างหน้า
ขยับไม่ได้!

shots.action: Through the windscreen: Kong half-turned, shouting back, his hand thrown toward the lorry; James beside him flinches as two palms slap the side glass.

shots.cut_on: พี่! ผมเคยผ่านแถวนี้

captions: พี่! ผมเคยผ่านแถวนี้

shots.action: James in the front passenger seat, helmet on, pointing past Kong to the left front, talking fast.
